chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mughīrah narrated from al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
ʿAlī عليه السلام said: “I do not care whether I cause hardship to my children or spend that wealth away on them.”

key_terms.سَرِفْتُهُمْ: I spent it away on them excessively or wastefully

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about disposing of wealth in a way that harms one’s children or heirs?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses conduct concerning wealth in relation to one’s children and heirs. It is cited in the context of harming heirs, indicating a legal-ethical concern regarding financial disposal that negatively affects the rights or welfare of one’s offspring.
